newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Woman and rebel die in clash with Colombian army.
newsitem.headline: Woman and rebel die in clash with Colombian army.

text.p: A woman being used as a human shield by leftist guerrillas was shot dead alongside one of the rebels during a clash with troops in northeastern Colombia, military sources said on Saturday.

The gunfight between the army and the National Liberation Army (ELN), Colombia's second largest guerrilla group, took place on Friday near the town of Zulia in Norte de Santander province, close to the border with Venezuela.
A seven-year-old girl also reported to have been injured during the exchange was released from hospital on Saturday after treatment, national radio said.
In a separate incident on Friday evening in Colombia's second largest city Cali, two police agents were slightly injured after suspected guerrillas dynamited a bus taking them to begin patrol duty.
A national police spokesman in Bogota said the 4.5 pound (2 kg) charge was detonated as the vehicle approached the city's international airport.
